error: Statically allocated circular buffers on core range [0-0 - 7-3] grow to 2012160 B which is beyond max L1 size of 1572864 B
where: ttnn.linear w1 in models/tt_transformers/tt/mlp.py during trace preparation (first prefill variant), tt_metal/impl/program/program.cpp:1875
explanation: The stock prefill MLP program configs size their circular buffers for bfp8 weights. With bf16 w1/w3 the in1 block of the 4096x12288 matmul on the 8x4 grid needs 2.01 MB of L1 per core against a 1.5 MB maximum. Making bf16 MLP weights fit needs a different in0_block_w / per-core N split in model_config.matmul_config, which is a framework change outside this port.
